raw_response:
My plot is small and rented, so I will not put too much money there, but here in Dar es Salaam I can still push it a bit because water and input shops are not too far. Last season I saw farmers near me who used bought seed, a little fertilizer, and spraying on small plots get better harvest than those who just planted local seed and waited. I will use improved seed, put some manure if I get it nearby, add a small amount of chemical fertilizer, and irrigate because on a plot this small I can manage it with family labor.
